questions.stem: What happens during depolarisation of a neurone?

options.text: Potassium ions rush out of the neurone
Sodium ions rush into the neurone, making the inside positive
The sodium-potassium pump becomes more active
The neurone becomes more negatively charged inside

questions.explanation: During depolarisation, sodium ion channels open and sodium ions rush into the neurone. This makes the inside of the neurone positively charged, reversing the resting potential.
